title: Mediator's Duty to Prepare Settlement Report

content.scenario: After mediation, a consumer, Priya, and a company reach a settlement. The mediator, Ms. Sharma, must prepare a report and forward the signed agreement to the concerned Commission.
content.outcome: The mediator, Ms. Sharma, is required to prepare a settlement report and forward the signed agreement along with the report to the concerned Commission, as per Section 80(2) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What happens after a settlement is reached in mediation?
What is the mediator's role after a settlement?
How is a settlement report prepared and submitted?
